routine: 단어 5분(예문 소리 내어 2번) → 패턴 5분(뼈대에 내 문장 넣기) → 위를 가리고 문제 3분 → 복습 2분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (11/10·11/03 표현 + 오답 2개), 영어로 먼저 써 보기

items.prompt: 서로 맞지 않는, 앞뒤가 다른 — do not match 대신
~를 못 하면 이유와 끝낼 수 있는 날짜를 알려 주세요 (패턴)
items.answer: If you cannot ~, please let me know the reason and the date you can ~.

items.prompt: A에는 ~라고 되어 있는 반면, B에는 ~라고 되어 있습니다 (패턴)

items.answer: I would appreciate it if you could ~.

cover_practice.prompt: 현재 보유한: How many masks do you have o_ h___?
내주다: Please i____ new uniforms only to new workers.
일할 계산하다: Please p______ the allowance for the days he worked.
되돌아가다: The working hours will r_____ to normal next week.
운송사에 금지가 끝나면 예전 가격으로 돌아가는지 확인해 주세요. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: Please confirm with the trucking company whether they will go back to the old price when the ban ends.

cover_practice.prompt: 견적을 하나 더 받아 주세요, 그래야 세 곳을 비교할 수 있습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: Please get one more quotation, so that we can compare three suppliers.

words.meaning: 현재 보유한, 가지고 있는 — already has 대신
words.example: Before buying, please check how many mops the department has on hand.
words.collocations: stock on hand / cash on hand

words.example: New tools are issued only when the old ones are returned.
words.collocations: issue A to B / issue a receipt

words.meaning: (일한 기간만큼) 일할 계산하다 — calculate by days 대신
words.example: Please prorate his first-month salary by the days he worked.
words.collocations: a prorated salary / on a prorated basis

words.example: Will the trucking company revert to the old price when the road ban ends?
words.collocations: revert to the old price / revert to normal

patterns.meaning: ~에게 ~인지 확인해 주세요 (확인할 상대를 같이 정해 줄 때)
patterns.email: Please confirm with the trucking company whether they will go back to the old price after the ban.
patterns.spoken: Can you check with them if the price goes back?

patterns.pattern: Please ~ in the same way as ~.
patterns.meaning: ~와 같은 방식으로 ~해 주세요 (전례대로 처리하라고 할 때)
patterns.skeleton: Please + [동사원형] + in the same way as + [명사] / as we did for + [명사]
patterns.email: Please calculate his November salary in the same way as we did for the last new manager.

patterns.meaning: ~해 주세요, 그래야 ~할 수 있습니다 (요청에 이유를 붙일 때)
patterns.email: Please get one more quotation, so that we can compare three suppliers.
patterns.spoken: Get one more, so we have three.

source: 11/10 보낸 메일(청소도구 지급 관리 지시, 운송사 단가 인상 확인 지시, 에어컨 견적 보완 요청, 신규 관리자 급여 일할 계산 안내, 보험 재견적 요청)
